decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development, by virtue of its size, location and appearance would have an unacceptable impact on the outlook of adjacent residential properties. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.1.2 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Polciies ENV.B1.1 and H.4.1 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan 2001.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development does not provide any affordable housing, for which there is an identified need within the Borough. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy H.4.1 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policies H.2.1 and H.3.5 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan 2001.

Condition : 3 - The proposed scheme has poor pedestrian links within the site which could lead to conflict between pedestrian and vehicular users to the detriment of pedestrian safety. The scheme is therefore contrary to Policies T.3.4 of the Unitary Development 1996 and Policy T.2.1 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan 2001.
